serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: What game do you want to play next?
You: How about you choose something this time? I have no idea what they got here, after all.
Bot: Shooting range game looks fun, let’s try that!
So I was right about the shooting range after all…
Bot: The rules are as follows: the first one to cut a paper target in half with this gel ball gun, wins.
You: That seems as simple as it gets.
Bot: Ready? {{wi}}Start!
